# Traffic Rescue

Traffic Rescue is an iPhone and iPad car puzzle game by Mansi Agarwal. Version 1.0 is waiting for App Review; downloads are not yet available. Five worlds contain 64 released-version puzzles: Parking Lot, City Rescue, Traffic Lights, Construction City and School Zone.

- [Official website](https://themansigoel.github.io/traffic-rescue-web/)
- [Gameplay, hints, Pro and iCloud support](https://themansigoel.github.io/traffic-rescue-web/support.html)
- [Privacy policy](https://themansigoel.github.io/traffic-rescue-web/privacy.html)
- [Contact](https://themansigoel.github.io/traffic-rescue-web/contact.html)

Two free hints per level. Free players can watch a rewarded ad for an extra hint; interstitials may appear after every third completed level. Lifetime Pro removes both ad formats; extra Pro hints cost 50 earned coins. Local progress supports optional Sync and Restore through private CloudKit storage. Firebase Analytics is automatically enabled; advertising consent is handled separately. No ratings, download totals or ranking guarantees are claimed.
